canonical_statement: For an elliptic differential operator D between smooth complex vector bundles over a compact smooth manifold, the Fredholm analytic index of D equals the topological index of its symbol class.
domain_and_universes: A compact smooth manifold X, finite-rank smooth complex vector bundles E and F over X, and an elliptic differential operator D : Gamma(E) -> Gamma(F); exact Lean universes and object models remain to be selected.
quantifiers: E F: smooth finite-rank complex vector bundles over X
D: elliptic differential operator from sections of E to sections of F
hypotheses: X is compact (closed/no-boundary convention must be pinned in the statement phase)
D is elliptic, so its principal symbol is invertible away from the zero section
the analytic realization of D is Fredholm
